svg.desc: Terminal: whoami returns Cydnee Owens, DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer. I'm a DevOps & infrastructure engineer who loves the quiet craft of systems that just work. I design cloud platforms, automate the toil out of delivery, and bring AI into everyday engineering workflows so teams can spend more time building what matters.
